question: Who is the author of 'Politics of Jugaad: The Coalition Handbook'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saba Naqvi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Saba Naqvi**__ is the best-known journalist in India.

 __
 
• She was the former political editor of Outlook magazine.
 
• 'Politics of Jugaad: The Coalition Handbook' is a book written by Saba Naqvi.
 
 
• The book examines the possibility of a coalition government after the 2019 Lok Sabha polls.
 
 
 
 
 
• Notable works of Saba Naqvi are:
 
 
• In Good Faith.
 
• Capital Conquest.
 
• Shades of Saffron: From Vajpayee to Modi.
